title: imap: STARTTLS not advertised or handled on plain port
description: crates/imap/src/session/commands.rs and mod.rs — STARTTLS is never advertised in CAPABILITIES on the plaintext port and no CommandBody::StartTls arm exists. RFC 3501 §6.2.1 requires STARTTLS on the plaintext port when TLS is configured. Compliant clients see LOGINDISABLED + no STARTTLS and refuse to authenticate, making the plain port unusable.
